description: The only way to give this round's execution review answer. Fill the three fields and call it; the platform builds and stores the answer from them. Do not write the answer as text.

parameters.basis: The short basis of the verdict: what you read and why it passes or needs rework. Non-empty, at most 4096 bytes.
parameters.report: The full review report; for fix, say what has to change. Non-empty.
